blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Tuesday urged women to keep leading and demanding space as the Philippines and fellow Southeast Asian countries move to push the region forward. In his speech at the 4th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Women Leaders’ Summit in Mandaluyong City, he cited the important role that women play in strengthening communities and driving the economy.
